content_sections.heading: Central Railway Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the Central Railway Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. content_sections.heading: Age Limit

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for Central Railway Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the total number of vacancies for Senior Resident posts in Central Railway?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Senior Resident posts, including Gen Surgery and Orthopedics specialties, in Central Railway recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the application mode for Central Railway Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Central Railway Senior Resident recruitment is Walk-in. Eligible candidates need to attend the interview directly on the specified date.

faq.question: Q3. What is the walk-in interview date for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Senior Resident posts at Central Railway is scheduled for 22 September 2026. Candidates should report on this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Senior Resident posts is 40 years. Age relaxation of 5 years is applicable for SC/ST candidates as per rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Senior Resident position at Central Railway?
faq.answer: The salary for the Senior Resident position is Rs. 67700 Per Month, along with other allowances like NPA, DA, Transportation, and HRA as applicable.

faq.question: Q6. What are the required qualifications for the Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Post Graduate Degree /DM/DNB or Diploma in the concerned specialty. MBBS with three years experience (including one year junior residency) is also acceptable if PG candidates are unavailable.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the Central Railway Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the Central Railway Senior Resident walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these Senior Resident vacancies?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Senior Resident posts involves two stages: Document Verification, followed by a Walk-in Interview with the selection committee.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the Central Railway office in Mumbai, Maharashtra. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the exact venue details.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies (ID, educational, experience, category certificates), and extra passport-size photographs for the interview.
